paragraphs.text: A chat box is not a finished product.

lined up TVs, phones, and cars: once the purpose is clear, the object gets out of the way. Software isn’t waiting decades for that. A few years after ChatGPT, a lot of apps are already just a chat box.
Four days earlier he wrote the other half: chat falls apart once agents start managing agents. You need the plan, the diagram, a before and after.
calls the usual chat window a log. The agent does the work somewhere you can’t see, and that gap is the actual design problem.
looked at the new Siri and skipped past the intelligence to the more interesting part. The phone already has the context. What people still need is to see where the assistant’s reach ends.
Chat is a fine place to start. It’s a bad place to leave the work.
